systems.country_label: extrait de naissance numérique / acte de naissance numérique
systems.tiers: commune civil status centres; Ratoma says it receives and enrols applicants from any commune; almost all communes of Conakry and of the interior are said to be affected by the stockout

note: The document describes the digital birth extract as a document citizens apply for at commune civil status centres (needed for a passport or identity card), with applicants enrolled whatever their commune, not as the registration of a birth when declared; so no civil fact. It states a stockout of secure paper lasting about a month by 7 August 2026 made issuance impossible in almost all communes of Conakry and the interior, per Ratoma's delegated civil status officer.
